mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (nickname, duck_id, phone, password_hash, ip_location, bio, avatar_url, follow_count, fans_count, like_count, status) VALUES (#{nickname}, #{duckId}, #{phone}, #{passwordHash}, #{ipLocation}, #{bio}, #{avatarUrl}, #{followCount}, #{fansCount}, #{likeCount}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET follow_count = follow_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET follow_count = follow_count - 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET fans_count = fans_count + 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET fans_count = fans_count - 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE users SET password_hash = #{passwordHash} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
